verdict.rationale: Preventing customer data from being used for AI model training is a fair privacy question for a cloud platform like Azure, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers AI-training data use, opt-out controls, or data-usage commitments. The items cover the CLI, infrastructure as code, RBAC, cost management, lifecycle policies and outages, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
